{{Quote|This endless war sees us destroy so much, and all in the name of the Republic&mdash;in the name of the Jedi!''"<br />"''What we do, we do because we ''must''. You have to believe that.|Barriss Offee and Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Paradise Lost" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phorose]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|What now? We can't just abandon the Ru here. They'll be slaughtered in the crossfire.''"<br />"''Our orders are to get to the evac point, so we'll just take them with us! What use is an evac point if you can't evacuate someone?|Barriss Offee and Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Paradise Lost" />}}
When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] invaded [[Phorose]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] to lead the defense of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

During the battle, the Padawans were ambushed by [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] and fell in an underground temple, leading to the accidental discovery of a community of [[Ru]]. However, a group of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] ambushed the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and destroyed the Ru temple. After the temple's destruction, Tano and Offee decided to evacuate the remaining Ru to a safe location, far from the battle. Unfortunately, the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] carrying the two Padawans and the Ru was ambushed by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], leading to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Ru, with only two Ru and the two Jedi surviving.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Anger, fear, hatred... These are the emotions of which a Jedi must be wary. But what about our ''guilt''?|Barriss Offee, questioning the ideals of the Jedi|<ref name="Paradise Lost" />}}
The battle ended with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory, however at a great cost, as most of the [[Phorosian]] capital was destroyed in the battle and the majority of the [[Ru]] were killed.

After witnessing the [[Death/Legends|death]] of these innocents, [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Offee]] started to question the ideals and motives of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], believing that the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were culpable for their deaths. In time, she reached the conclusion that the Jedi Order had become an instrument of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], by becoming [[Jedi General/Legends|generals]] in a war to protect a corrupt [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. This encouraged Offee to help in a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|terrorist act against the Jedi Order]] and [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|blame it]] on Tano, her closest friend.
